body.p: Please amend the claims as follows:
body.br:
1. (currently amended) Optical vital signs sensor (100) configured to measure or determine vital signs of a user, comprising a photoplethysmographic (PPG) sensor (102) having comprising a light source (110) configured to generate light which is directed towards a skin (1000) of the user, a photo detector unit (120) configured to detect light, wherein said light being indicative of a reflection of light emitted in or from the skin (1000) of the user and a contact surface (101) configured to be placed against a skin (1000) of a user, wherein the light from the light source (110) is directed towards the skin (1000) of the user via the contact surface (101), a force measuring unit (130) configured to measure a force applied via the contact surface of the PPG sensor (102) to the skin (1000) of the user, and
a force actuator configured to apply a force to the skin of the user, and
a processing unit (110) configured to extract information regarding a blood volume pulse from an output signal of the PPG sensor (102) during a linear increase of the force applied by the force actuator to the skin of the user and to map the extracted information to a blood pressure value at the specific force applied to the skin of the user via the contact surface of the PPG sensor (102).
2. (currently amended) Optical vital signs sensor (100) according to claim 1, wherein the optical vital signs sensor (100) is a wrist worn optical vital signs sensor.
3. (cancelled)
4. (cancelled)
5. (currently amended) Optical vital signs sensor (100) according to claim 41, further comprising a wristband (103) having a cavity (103a) in which a distensible membrane (160) is arranged, wherein the membrane (160) can be inflated or deflated by means of an air pump unit (150) in order to apply pressure to the PPG sensor (102).
6. (currently amended) Optical vital signs sensor (100) according to claim 2, wherein the force transducer (130) is coupled to the PPG sensor (102) in order to detect a force at which the PPG sensor (102) is pressed against a skin (1000) of a user.
7. (currently amended) Optical vital signs sensor according to claim -31, wherein the force applied to the skin of the user is > 15 N.
8. (original) Optical vital signs sensor according to claim 1, wherein the blood pressure value is a Mean Arterial Pressure.
9. (currently amended) Method of measuring or determining vital signs of a user with an optical vital signs sensor (100) configured to measure or determine vital signs of a user, said optical vital signs sensor being a PPG sensor having a contact surface (101), a force actuator configured to apply a force to a skin of the user, at least one light source (110) for generating light which is directed towards a skin (1000) of a user and at least one photo detector unit (120) configured to detect light which is indicative of a reflection of light emitted in or from the skin (1000) of a user, comprising the steps of:
applying a force to the PPG sensor (102) to press the contact surface of the PPG sensor (102) against to the a-skin (1000) of a user by means of the force actuator, emitting light from at least one light source (110) towards the skin (1000) of the user and detecting the reflective light by the at least one photo detector, measuring a force at which the contact surface of the PPG sensor (102) is pressed against a skin (1000) of a user, extracting blood volume pulse information from an output signal of the PPG sensor (102) and mapping the extracted blood volume pulse information to a blood pressure value at a specific force applied to the contact surface of the PPG sensor (102).
wherein the extracting of blood volume pulse information from the output signal of the PPG sensor is performed during a ramp up of the force applied to the skin of the user via the contact surface of the PPG sensor.
10. (original) Method of measuring or determining vital signs of a user according to claim 9, further comprising the steps:
measuring a blood pressure with an external device, and
calibrating the mapping based on the measured blood pressure.
11. (cancelled)
12. (currently amended) Method of measuring or determining vital signs of a user according to claim 9, wherein only the contact surface (101) of the PPG sensor (102) is used to apply the force to the skin (1000) of the user.
13. (currently amended) A computer program product comprising a computer readable memory storing computer program code means for causing the optical vital signs sensor according to claim 1 to carry out the steps of measuring or determining vital signs of a user. according to claims 9 to 12.
14. (new) Optical vital signs sensor according to claim 2, wherein the force actuator is configured to apply a force to the skin of the user via the PPG sensor.
